question: What is the literacy rate of India as per the National Survey of India-2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**77.7%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **77.7%** is the literacy rate of India as per the National Survey of India-2022.
 
• The literacy rate measures the percentage of people aged 7 and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• It is an important indicator of educational attainment and socio-economic development in the country.
 
• The survey conducted takes into account various demographic factors including age, gender, and region to provide a comprehensive overview of literacy in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The National Survey of India** is conducted periodically to assess various socio-economic indicators, including literacy rates.
 
• Efforts to improve literacy rates in India include various government initiatives like the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and the National Literacy Mission.
 
• Literacy is crucial for empowering individuals and enabling them to participate fully in the socio-economic development of the country.
 
• Continuous efforts are being made to bridge the literacy gap between different regions and demographic groups in India.
